prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Draw one isolated medieval city defensive curtain-wall module for a fantasy pixel-art game. Solid pure magenta #ff00ff background. Large clean pixel drawing, intended to be registered down to exactly 288 pixels wide and 96 pixels tall. Very wide horizontal front-facing wall, three-quarter town view from above, front face facing down toward viewer. Straight perfectly level bottom and sides. Top silhouette has EIGHT substantial rectangular battlements with square notches. Show top walking ledge as a shallow horizontal strip, then a continuous solid wall of varied rectangular warm grey sandstone ashlar masonry below. Wall occupies entire width; left/right cropped masonry continues seamlessly, no end towers, no pillars, no grass. No doors, no windows, no arch, no vines, no ground, no shadow cast outside silhouette. Light top-left, right/lower masonry shading olive grey. Strong single native-pixel dark brown outline. Crisp material clusters, few muted warm limestone colours, simple art at same scale as a 48px storey. Squares, not rounded stones. Must look like a castle wall, solid and fortified. No text, no blur, no gradients, no loose specks. Draw at large size on magenta with clear margins.

Use case: stylized-concept. One standalone modular fortified medieval city wall, large pixel-art painting isolated on pure solid #ff00ff magenta. Native target 288x96 pixels, a wide straight horizontal rectangle with SIX broad square merlons and five squared notches along top. Elevated three-quarter view, buildings would face down; front wall faces viewer. Low raised top parapet, visible narrow walkway top, tall flat front made of several offset courses of substantial rectangular limestone blocks. Warm muted stone, dark brown thin outlines, top-left light and deeper olive-grey shading under battlements. More restrained than a detailed illustration, precise square clusters and straight bottom edge, no perspective vanishing, no narrowing at ends. Horizontal stone courses reach both edges so the module can repeat. No tower, window, arrow slit, doorway, plant, ground, cast shadow, ornament, text, noise or haze. Preserve strong shapes at 288x96 after reduction. Large wide painted module with magenta margins.

Use case: stylized-concept. A pixel-art sprite sheet of FOUR distinct medieval townspeople, standing full body in one evenly spaced horizontal row, no grid lines, on solid pure magenta #ff00ff background. Each person drawn large for later reduction to 18 pixels wide by 32 pixels tall, with clear magenta gap between every figure. Fantasy town game elevated three-quarter front-facing view, facing down toward viewer. Left to right: woman in cream blouse and muted terracotta skirt holding a small bread basket; man in ochre tunic with brown belt and trousers; merchant woman in pale blue-grey long dress with cream apron; man in olive cloak and brown cap carrying a small pack. Natural simple small-game proportions, heads slightly large but not chibi. Top-left light, thin dark brown outline, flat limited palette with clear square clusters. Arms touch bodies or carried items, legs join torso, no detached bits. No ground, no oval shadows, no labels, no scene, no blur, no gradients, no rim light. Entire bodies visible and all feet on one baseline, all at same scale.

Use case: stylized-concept. Four full-body fantasy medieval market NPC sprites on solid pure magenta #ff00ff, widely separated in one horizontal row. These are large pixel drawings to reduce to 18x32 native pixels each, designed for a 48px-cell town view. Slightly elevated camera, looking down at front-facing people. 1: brown-haired woman in ochre dress with linen apron and basket. 2: bearded workman in muted rust tunic, leather belt, dark trousers. 3: grey-haired shopkeeper in muted slate-blue robe carrying a bundle. 4: traveller in olive-green short cloak with brown boots and hood down. Keep silhouettes narrow, sturdy and connected, feet separated by a clear notch; body and head readable at tiny scale. Native one-pixel dark brown outline, top-left light, 3-shade material ramps in subdued earthy medieval colours. Crisp square pixel clusters, no realistic rendering, no noise, no specks, no antialias, no haze. Whole figures from head to boots, equal height, feet aligned. Pure magenta around and between figures, no painted floor, shadow, UI, borders, captions or text.
